brains.heading: Brains
brains.defaultsDesc: Initial embedding model (provider:model) and dimensions used when creating a brain. Precedence: this setting > the brain environment's GBrain config > built-in default. New brains only; to switch an existing brain use gbrain migrate embeddings.
brains.defEmbedInvalid: Invalid format: the model needs a provider prefix (provider:model); dimensions must be a positive integer

templates.heading: Employee templates
templates.name: Name
templates.none: No templates yet — create one, then deploy AI employees from the user console
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete template "{name}"? Deployed employees are not affected.

obridge.heading: Mail bridge (obridge)
obridge.desc: The external event bridge: inbound mail (IMAP) becomes employee events; employee replies go out via SMTP. Settings live in obridge.toml on the server; saving validates via obridge --check.
obridge.autostart: Managed by this service (auto-start the obridge child process)
obridge.autostartHint: When enabled and saved, oserver starts/restarts obridge automatically; otherwise the deployer manages the process.
obridge.exeMissing: obridge executable not found (expected next to oserver, or set AppConfig.obridge_executable)
obridge.notEnabledHint: Enable "Managed by this service" and save first
obridge.modeManagedHint: obridge runs on this server: ingress URL and secret are written automatically by the server (server token) — no input needed.
obridge.modeManualHint: obridge deploys on a machine that can reach the mail server: enter the oserver /event URL and secret (master token or [ingress].secret), then copy the config file to that machine.
obridge.listenHint: obridge's receive endpoint (127.0.0.1 only). In managed mode oserver writes the address and secret into its own settings automatically (reply loop).
obridge.listenSecretAuto: Empty = keep; empty on first setup = auto-generate
obridge.keepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current value
obridge.noChannels: No channels yet — add an email-imap channel to start receiving mail.
obridge.preserved: {n} non-mail channel(s) kept in the config file (not editable here):
obridge.removeChannelConfirm: Remove this channel? (takes effect on save)
obridge.subject: Default outgoing subject
obridge.optBrains: Brains (wakes all employees sharing the brain)
obridge.act.restarted: Saved — ingress/listen changed, obridge restarted automatically
obridge.exeBuildMismatch: Warning: the obridge executable's build does not match this server (likely a stale binary) — run cargo dev-build again or update the deployment package
